scope.description: Software that competes with Logic4 for the ERP-plus-webshop budget of mid-sized non-food trading companies in the Netherlands and Belgium (and Germany secondarily).
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: Dutch/Belgian SME ERPs, POS-plus-ecommerce platforms and mid-market ERPs that buyers compare with Logic4. Excluded: Katapull siblings (Vendit, Highbiza, EffectConnect, DeliveryMatch, Transus, Returnista, Picqer), which are complements modeled in sibling domains, and generic accounting-only tools.
scope.notes: Stats are only given where an official source with scope was found; Logic4 itself publishes no customer count (it states 500+ webshops run on its platform). Absence of a stat is not evidence of size.

players.name: Exact Online (Wholesale/Trade)
players.description: Dutch cloud business software with editions for wholesale and distribution; frequently combined with a separate webshop platform and connectors. The default alternative for Dutch SMEs already using Exact accounting.

players.name: AFAS Profit
players.description: Dutch ERP suite with order management, logistics and finance used by mid-sized companies; less webshop-centric, typically paired with a separate commerce platform.

players.name: Lightspeed Commerce
players.description: POS and e-commerce platform for retailers and hospitality with a strong Benelux retail base (from the former SEOshop/Lightspeed eCom); competes for store-plus-webshop retailers rather than wholesale ERP.

businessStats.sourceTitle: Lightspeed Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2026 Financial Results

players.name: Shopify (with POS and ERP connectors)
players.description: Global commerce platform with POS and B2B features; Dutch traders combine it with an ERP or accounting package via connectors. Competes for the webshop budget and for customers who prefer best-of-breed over all-in-one.

players.name: Odoo
players.description: Open-source modular ERP with website, POS, inventory and accounting apps; competes on breadth and price, often implemented by partners.

players.name: JTL-Software
players.description: German merchant suite (JTL-Wawi ERP, shop, POS, WMS, marketplaces, EDI, shipping, returns) - the closest functional analogue to an all-in-one commerce ERP plus hub, relevant for Logic4's German customers.

businessStats.scope: JTL merchant community as stated on homepage

players.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (partner solutions)
players.description: Mid-market ERP sold through partners with wholesale and retail add-ons; the typical destination for traders who outgrow an all-in-one package.
